name: 12-feedback
description: feedback() writes one span. With a valid turn ref, the span is a child of the turn span. With no turn ref, or an invalid one, it joins a trace derived from the session. Each kind writes its typed attributes.
covers: practice 6: feedback with turn.ref as its turn joins the turn's trace as a child of the turn span
practice 6: feedback joins its turn, not the span active when it is written
practice 6: a rating writes event.name and the feedback.* attributes FLS queries read, with reasons joined by commas
practice 6: namespace writes the typed attributes under its prefix, so tester ratings keep tester.*
practice 6: each behaviour signal writes its kind, its ADR 005 class and its typed attributes, and event.name defaults to feedback.<kind>
practice 6: attributes are written as given, after the typed ones, and an attribute cannot replace event.name
practice 6: feedback with a turn ref of another process joins that trace, under that span
practice 6: feedback with no turn ref joins one trace per session, derived from the session id, with a parent span that is never written
practice 6: feedback with an invalid turn ref joins its session's trace
practice 6: feedback with no turn ref and no session joins one session, and one trace, for the process
practice 6: the feedback span is INTERNAL, on the flywheel tracer, and starts and ends at the at time, default now
practice 6: feedback writes no log record by default
